# Book of Giants Fragment 7 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

This log records all lines in Book of Giants Fragment 7 (The Battle of the Giants) where the three translators diverged, along with SOPHIA's resolution.

---

## 7:4 — "Ohya prevailed / Ohya was stronger"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "but-Ohya prevailed" — Aramaic yakhil |
| LOGOS | "but Ohya prevailed" — formal |
| PNEUMA | "but Ohya was stronger" — flattens the victory verb |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS "Ohya prevailed." The verb implies active overcoming, not merely being stronger.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 7:8 — "feasted upon / gorged themselves"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "they-feasted upon-its-flesh" — literal |
| LOGOS | "they feasted upon its flesh" — formal |
| PNEUMA | "they gorged themselves on its meat" — intensified |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS "feasted upon its flesh." PNEUMA's "gorged" adds gluttony not necessarily in the Aramaic.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 7:14 — "noise reached to heaven / heard in heaven"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the-noise reached to-heaven" — literal |
| LOGOS | "the noise reached to heaven" — formal |
| PNEUMA | "so loud it could be heard in heaven" — restructured |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS "the noise reached to heaven." Preserves the Aramaic image of sound traveling upward.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

*Total disagreements for Fragment 7: 3*
